shared_elements: carved stone surface with relief figures
multiple figures crowded on one face
raised relief with rounded modelled bodies
justification: Both are stone monuments bearing multiple animal figures rendered in relief, including profile quadrupeds and a coiled curvilinear form, which is about as far as the correspondence goes. A is a flat rectangular slab with figures disciplined into stacked horizontal registers and crisp, shallow, sharply outlined carving, whereas B is an irregular boulder whose weathered, coarse-grained, higher and more rounded relief spreads over a convex surface with no register scheme or evident ordering.
